topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 349 project-authored contract(s) across 9 chain(s); 3 ERC4626 vaults, 54 ERC20 tokens, 14 ERC721 NFTs, 5 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 96 common project-authored base contract(s) (cerc20, ctokeninterface, ctokenstorage). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
